meta.title: Local development environment (v6_api, c2c_ui, optional services)

boundaries.label: v6_api stack: dev container, or uv venv + docker compose

cards.title: Two ways to run v6_api
items: Dev container (recommended, README.md): VS Code 'Reopen in Container', or the same Compose stack from a terminal; setup.sh runs uv sync, writes the .ini files, migrates the restored dev database and runs make init-elastic (keeps the prebuilt index when its fingerprint matches the indexing code, else rebuilds it, about 5 min, more under amd64 emulation)

Manual (not recommended, HOWTO-MANUAL-DEV.md): make bootstrap (start, install, load-env, init-database, init-test-database, init-elastic), then make serve, make run-syncer and make run-background-jobs in three terminals
Check: http://localhost:6543/health · tests: make test (pytest -n 4, one database per worker)

cards.title: Dev data
items: c2corg-dev-db: PostgreSQL 18 + PostGIS restoring a ~110 MB anonymized extract of production on first start, already at the latest alembic revision; test accounts moderator, user, blocked, unvalidated
c2corg-dev-es: Elasticsearch 2.4 with the index of that database, published with the same tag
Both setups use this pair: .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml and the root docker-compose.yml (manual setup) start the same images, with separate volumes

cards.title: c2c_ui against the local API
items: npm run serve starts on the production backend: pick 'localhost' in the backend selector of the navbar (C2C_API_URL overrides http://localhost:6543)
Media, image upload and forum of 'localhost' default to demov6 (C2C_MEDIA_URL, C2C_IMAGE_BACKEND_URL, C2C_FORUM_URL)
CORS: config/env.dev allows http://localhost:6553 (ui_url, the e2e port) and http://localhost:8080 (npm run serve)
e2e: the test user is created by e2e/create-user.py, run in the v6_api environment

cards.title: Optional services
items: No Discourse locally: discourse_enabled=false, comments answer 503
c2c_images: STORAGE_BACKEND=local; it listens on 8080 like Vite, so set SERVICE_PORT; S3 tests use an in-memory Scality server on :9000
c2c_tracking (Node 26+): its compose PostgreSQL also publishes 5432, so move one of them; it needs the API's JWT secret, and provider webhooks need a public URL (ngrok)

cards.title: Docs that disagree with the code
items: wiki.api 'Development environment on Linux' still lists Python 3.4 and PostgreSQL 9.4; README.md (dev container) and HOWTO-MANUAL-DEV.md are the reference
wiki.api 'Dev databases' still gives the logins of the 2018 dump
wiki.ui 'Build environment' still names vue.config.js and the demo API as the default of npm run serve
